title: Adic separation of sheafified free representables
statement: Let l be prime and X a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let R be purTwistRing of the positive finite-ring limit purTwistZlCompletion [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings]. For U in X.ProEt whose structure morphism is proAffineEtale, that is a small cofiltered limit of absolutely affine etale X-schemes [sk-def-pe-morphisms], let P be the module sheafification of the free R-presheaf on the universe-lifted representable of U [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. If x in P(V) is locally divisible by l^(n+1) for every natural n, then x=0. Precisely, for every n the image sieve of multiplication by l^(n+1) on the underlying abelian sheaf, evaluated at x, is covering. This asserts separation of this explicit target, with no source module, coefficient comparison, or additive map.

proof.text: Each finite coefficient ring sheaf is killed by l^(n+1): its canonical map from the constant Z/l^(n+1) presheaf preserves the corresponding zero natural-number scalar. Thus any locally l^(n+1)-divisible coefficient section has zero n-th projection, by naturality and sheaf separatedness. Evaluation preserves the limit defining the completed ring, so all projections jointly detect zero. These are finiteCoefficient_nsmul and coefficient_adicSeparated in Lean.

A local R-linear functional on the slice over W sends the restriction of x to a locally infinitely l-divisible coefficient. Pull back each given image cover along W to V, apply the functional to its explicit divisibility witnesses and use its naturality and linearity. The preceding coefficient argument kills its value. This is localDual_zero in Lean.
Apply local-dual detection for the free sheaf on the pro-affine etale representable. All tests vanish by the preceding step, so x=0.

lean.statement:
theorem completedFree_adicSeparated (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (hU : proAffineEtale U.unop.hom) :
    let R := Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l)
    let P := (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R.obj)).obj
      ((PresheafOfModules.free R.obj).obj (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj U.unop))
    ∀ (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : P.val.obj V),
      (∀ n : ℕ, Presheaf.imageSieve
        ((l ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj P)).hom) x ∈
          Scheme.ProEt.topology X V.unop) → x = 0

old_proof.text: Locally lift x through the unit of module sheafification. Such a lift has finite support in the free presheaf. For each positive exponent, refine the cover to represent the asserted divisibility and the equality in sheafification by an equality in the free presheaf.

Use repleteness of the pro-etale topos and the pro-etale covering refinements in its proof to obtain a common covering refinement carrying the countable compatible sequence of representatives and equalities. After restriction there, all equalities hold in the free presheaf with the fixed representative of x.

In this free module group identical basis vectors. Every coefficient of the fixed finite support is divisible by every positive l-power, so its images under all finite coefficient projections vanish. These projections jointly detect zero in the specified limit R. Thus all the coefficients vanish, and the local representative of x is zero. The separatedness axiom for the module sheaf descends this equality to V.
